subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw trust and adopt these 14 new executable GitHub Action commits across token, security-scanning, release, Docker, maintenance, and Codex-agent workflows?
rationale: The PR changes code executed with sensitive credentials or repository permissions and carries a protected security label; CI alone cannot establish whether every upstream security and behavior change is acceptable.

options.title: Audit and approve batch
options.body: Rebase, verify every official release SHA, complete the direct Codex-source audit, and merge after representative workflow gates pass.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate token, release, CodeQL, Docker login, and Codex updates from lower-privilege setup-action bumps to reduce review scope.

options.title: Retain current pins
options.body: Defer the batch if maintainers cannot complete the upstream source and credential-boundary audit confidently.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve batch
recommendation.body: Rebase, verify every official release SHA, complete the direct Codex-source audit, and merge after representative workflow gates pass.
